item.text:
I can’t confirm it for you. Greybeard requires human confirmation locally; your AGENTS.md explicitly says, “Never perform this human confirmation for them or invent a chat/automation exception.”

Review the exact candidate content in the Greybeard companion, then confirm there or run this in your own terminal:

```bash
greybeard memory confirm --id <candidate-id>
```

Your “yes” in chat doesn’t replace that step.
